numbers.title: In numbers
numbers.context: For 5+ years at Blackboard Anthology, I built for a learning platform, contributing to end-to-end projects in assessment and content authoring.

projects.title: Featured projects
projects.intro: Proof, not adjectives. Each case in four steps: the problem, what I built, the result and the stack.

items.title: AI assistant for Servicios Informáticos
items.problem: A B2B services company needed its website to generate qualified inbound leads.
items.built: End-to-end delivery of the corporate site (discovery, information architecture, design system and development) and an AI assistant built on Claude that answers visitors' questions from the site's own content and pre-drafts their WhatsApp message.
items.result: The assistant is active for every visitor and turns questions into pre-drafted WhatsApp leads, one tap away from contacting the business.

items.title: AI-assisted assessment authoring
items.problem: Instructors needed a faster way to build assessments targeted to a specific topic or class.
items.built: On my own initiative, a working AI feature powered by GPT that helps instructors generate questions from a topic or an existing question bank, improve their texts and get suggested grading feedback.
items.result: A working end-to-end demo inside a platform serving 100M+ users, built on my own initiative.

items.title: Rosita Store platform
items.problem: The business's original e-commerce site went down, taking its online sales with it.
items.built: A rebuilt e-commerce platform on new infrastructure, plus internal tooling and operational databases that automate the business's commercial processes.
items.result: Restored the business's online sales. Live at rositastore.co.

items.title: ML segmentation for Sportlife
items.problem: A Chilean gym chain wanted to expand customer retention.
items.built: A client-data-driven segmentation system with ML-based preference prediction, feeding a targeted-campaign system, alongside a full booking module and fingerprint access control.
items.result: ML-based segmentation feeding targeted retention campaigns.

items.title: Easymail, as the sole developer
items.problem: A shipping-management platform needed a backend, a web back office and an iOS/Android app.
items.built: All three, as the only developer on the project.

points: Built and shipped an AI assistant (Claude) for the Servicios Informáticos website that answers visitor questions from the site's own content and pre-drafts a WhatsApp message.
Rebuilt Rosita Store's e-commerce platform on new infrastructure after the original site went down, and built the internal tooling that automates its commercial processes.
Use agentic AI coding tools (Claude Code) across the full project lifecycle: spec, implementation, review and documentation.
Contributed to 50+ end-to-end projects on a global learning platform serving 100M+ users across 70 countries, owning scope, planning and full-stack implementation on the projects I led.
Designed and prototyped, on my own initiative, a working GPT-powered assessment-authoring feature.
Became the team's go-to engineer for performance and accessibility (WCAG, Section 508), and turned both into everyday standards.
Promoted from Junior to Mid-Senior Engineer within the first year.
Designed and implemented ML-based customer segmentation (scikit-learn) for Sportlife, a Chilean gym chain, feeding targeted retention campaigns.
Shipped Easymail as the sole developer: backend, web back office and iOS/Android app.
Deployed and administered AWS infrastructure (EC2, S3) across three production products.

howIWork.title: How I work

items.title: AI product features
items.body: I bring AI into products where it creates real value. On my own initiative I prototyped a GPT-powered authoring feature at Blackboard; today I ship assistants built on Claude, and I use Claude Code from spec to implementation, review and documentation.

items.title: Performance at scale
items.body: Five years building for a platform serving 100M+ users across 70 countries. I tested the performance of every project I delivered and presented degradation metrics in Definition of Done reviews.

items.title: Accessible by design
items.body: I became the team's go-to engineer for accessibility (WCAG, Section 508), testing features with screen readers and turning best practices into everyday standards. This site is built to the same bar.

howIWork.teamLabel: What I bring to a team
howIWork.team: ownership from day one, a high bar for quality, and the initiative to propose what's next, not just build what's asked.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: I'm looking for a senior full-stack or AI product engineering role in a remote, product-driven company where I can own an area end to end, ideally in a product with real impact on people's lives.
